description: The player's side of a live round: the question is on the big screen, and each phone shows big lettered tiles to pick from. The first pick is final and goes to the host; the pad then says the answer is in and waits. When the host reveals the round, the pad…

## @interlace/answer-pad

Installed to `components/ui/games/answer-pad.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/answer-pad';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/answer-pad

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
